claims.explanation: The most striking pattern is that nearly every selectively killed line carries a damaging TP53 mutation, while the least-affected lines are enriched for TP53-wildtype or non-TP53-driven lineages (e.g., BRAF-mutant melanomas, PIK3CA/PTEN-driven tumors). Desoxycortone, as a mineralocorticoid receptor (NR3C2) agonist, may activate glucocorticoid/mineralocorticoid receptor signaling that preferentially induces apoptosis or growth arrest in cells lacking functional p53, since p53 is a key mediator of steroid-induced cell-cycle arrest and survival. Thus TP53 loss-of-function is the strongest sensitizing feature, with additional modulation by lineage and cooperating mutations.
